deliberately_excluded.what_remains_verifiable: Recipients can check that the publication receipt and all three candidate-arm reports RECORD the same tree digest.

deliberately_excluded.superseded_overclaim: An earlier draft said 'tree identity remains verifiable without shipping the payload'. That was too strong: without the payload only the CONSISTENCY OF RECORDED DIGESTS ACROSS REPORTS is checkable, not the tree itself.

adapter_tree_identity.rename_reason: The predicate was attached to the wrong subject. The evidence supports RECORDED tree identity; the old id and its 'exact loaded adapter tree identity' description asserted LOADED identity, which the same artifact's own unsupported_scope denied. A claim may not be named LOADED and simultaneously disclaim runtime attestation.
adapter_tree_identity.supported_scope: The same adapter tree digest is RECORDED in all three candidate-arm evaluation reports (SYNTHETIC_TEST, MANUAL_BLIND, DEV) and in the training publication receipt; all three baseline-arm reports carry a null adapter field. Each DEV report is additionally pinned by sha256 from the DEV paired report's candidate_report_sha256 / baseline_report_sha256 fields.
adapter_tree_identity.unsupported_scope: RECORDED, NOT LOADED. Does not prove the in-process weights at inference time equalled the on-disk tree; the binding is report-recorded, not runtime-attested. Forbidden readings: 'exact loaded adapter identity established', 'runtime-loaded weights proved', 'adapter payload independently verified'.

claim_coverage.note: These are ORIGINAL frozen primary artifacts, not 2026-08-31 rederivations. They must NOT carry the REDERIVED_FROM_FROZEN_INPUTS / NOT_ORIGINAL_RUN labels.

verified_by_recount.method: per-row recount over the 45-element results array grouped by family

classes.unsupported_scope: VISUAL_CONDITION_SELECTION 0/12 is evidence of a task-identifiability defect (the expected answer requires an internal ID absent from the input), not a measurement of model visual ability.

classes.supported_scope: Under this configuration the adapter produced no authorizable incremental benefit on either primary split. On SYNTHETIC_TEST no case changed in any direction. On MANUAL_BLIND the headline expectation-match metric was unchanged with zero discordant pairs; strict-valid and reassociation-boundary rose by exactly one case out of 45, which is below the pre-set 0.05 practical minimum, has a confidence interval whose lower bound is 0, and carries an explicit unstable-interval flag.
classes.unsupported_scope: Does NOT establish non-regression. primary_ci_not_negative is true on both primary splits, but the intervals are explicitly flagged UNSTABLE_LOW_CLUSTER_COUNT (2 and 3 clusters), so absence of a detected drop is weak evidence, not proof that capability did not decline. Also does not generalize beyond this adapter, this data, and this two-shot family-first prompting policy.

classes.across_splits_quantifier_now_satisfied: All three splits named in the ACROSS_SPLITS claim (DEV, SYNTHETIC_TEST, MANUAL_BLIND) now have an in-package candidate-arm report recording the same adapter tree digest. Before the second read-only pass this claim's quantifier ranged over three splits while the package held evidence for only two.
classes.exactly_four_bindings: The recorded-tree-identity claim is supported by exactly these four artifacts: one publication receipt plus the three candidate-arm reports. Nothing else may be attached to it.

removed_from_primary_artifacts.reason: It contains NO tree digest. Verified: grep for the tree digest and for adapter_tree_sha256 both return zero hits. Listing it here made the evidence set over-inclusive — it looked like a fifth binding when it binds nothing.
removed_from_primary_artifacts.correct_role: It is a MEMBER of the published tree; its per-file sha256 appears in the publication receipt's published_manifest. That supports tree COMPOSITION, not cross-split RECORDED IDENTITY. Two different claims.
removed_from_primary_artifacts.found_by: m2c-exec pre-build semantic self-audit, 2026-08-31. The error originated in this receipt (tzb-fe) and was inherited by the evidence index.
removed_from_primary_artifacts.error_shape: Same family as the eight meta-layer findings of 2026-08-31: the artifact is genuine, the digests are correct, and the predicate attached to it was wrong. Here the wrong predicate was 'supports the recorded-identity claim'.
